policy: The registry tables are defined by the exact reviewed shared-definitions segment and applied verbatim by src/rust-orm/migrations.rs. Do not author an independent schema in this crate. The registry lives in public behind the zed_ prefix because pg-defs generated identifiers are keyed by bare table name. Schema changes are reviewed in ORESoftware/k8s-libs-and-shared-defs first, then vendored and repinned here.
